# Trinath Kondapalli — UX/UI Designer & Web Developer

> Senior UX/UI Designer & Design-to-Live Developer specializing in high-converting web applications, micro-interactions, and AI-accelerated workflows.

## Primary Services
- **UX/UI Design**: User research, information architecture, wireframing, and design systems for web and mobile products.
- **Website Design & Development**: End-to-end design-to-live production builds using AI-accelerated workflows and Next.js / React.
- **Interactive & Motion-Led Web**: Code-based animations, page transitions, and micro-interactions using GSAP and Framer Motion.

## Selected Case Studies
- **NutriBox**: D2C wellness e-commerce platform redesign (+40% conversion rate).
- **LinguLink**: Social language learning app (100k+ active users).
- **Go Vigi**: B2B agricultural logistics and bulk ordering portal (60% faster checkout).
